notes.title: Kickstarter for our new MIDI controller now live!
notes.content:
Our latest product, Poly Expressive, the MIDI foot controller that lets you control parameters with your feet, giving you a lot of the deep control that The Music Room has but for controlling guitar pedals, amps and DAW is now on Kickstarter:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1961989452/poly-expressive-midi-foot-control-dont-switch-cont

notes.title: Tombé Drums VR now available
notes.content:
The drum focused part of The Music Room family is now available, including an very full featured free demo:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/632620/Tomb_Drums_VR/

The demo is a great way to try out the drum features of The Music Room and if you later want MIDI or DAW integration you can trade up.
